description.en: The plugin index shipped alongside dsh-transcript-export.
description.zh: 与 dsh-transcript-export 一起发布的插件索引。

description.en: Turn any reply into a document you can hand to someone: clean Markdown, one self-contained HTML file, or JSON. Take the last N turns, get tool calls folded into one appendix per round, real Markdown structure with a table of contents, and secrets redacted by default — all read from the session log, never modified.
description.zh: 把任意一条回复变成能拿给人看的文档：干净的 Markdown、单文件 HTML 或 JSON。可以只导最近 N 轮，工具调用整轮折进一个附录，正文是真 Markdown 结构还带目录，密钥默认脱敏——全程只读会话日志，不改动它。
